thread_analysis.thread_summary: Ito-en (beverage company) inquired about Bluetooth certification for a consumer device. On checking the SIG Member Directory, the company was not found — meaning they are not yet a SIG member. SIG membership is a prerequisite for certification. The consultant must direct the customer to register as a SIG Adopter or Associate Member before any certification work can proceed.
all_questions_found: Our company is not in the SIG Member Directory — can we still proceed with Bluetooth certification?
thread_analysis.key_technical_discussion: SIG membership is a hard prerequisite for Bluetooth qualification. Without membership, no Qualification Workspace or QDID can be associated with the company. The minimum membership tier for certification is Adopter Member.
thread_analysis.key_decision_logic: Check SIG Member Directory at intake. Not found → membership required first. Certification process cannot start until membership is confirmed.
thread_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Starting work before membership is established wastes both consultant and customer time, as no registration can be completed without a valid SIG member account.
thread_analysis.consulting_mistake: Proceeding with project scoping or quoting without first verifying the customer's SIG membership status.
thread_analysis.consulting_takeaway: SIG Member Directory check must be step 1 of every new customer intake. If the customer is not found, pause all other steps and direct them to register as a SIG member before proceeding.
